subject: APSILON: Workshop slotting, on-site readiness & virtual fallback windows

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Keller <alex.keller@apsilon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: APSILON: Workshop slotting, on-site readiness & virtual fallback windows

Hi Alex —

Quick note to lock down the week-of dates for the two-day exec workshop you and Jordan requested. We have a handful of constraints to balance (AV load, regional exec availability, and travel windows for the EMEA leads). Proposed primary on-site days: Sept 20–21 at your SF office, with Sept 22 reserved as an all-remote buffer in case any travel hiccups occur.

As part of prework, could you confirm:
- preferred kickoff (0900 or 1100 PT) on day 1
- expected number of in-person attendees by Sept 10 (we've budgeted 12 seats)
- whether the office can support 4 simultaneous breakout Zoom rooms (AV + ethernet)

We'll publish calendar holds for the tentative slots and share a draft itinerary + site map. If travel for EMEA leads tightens, we want to be explicit about virtual fallback hours so we can route presenters to the right timebands.

Thanks — sending a separate note to ops with the AV checklist.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Ben — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers:
- Kickoff at 11:00 PT works better for our execs (gives arrival buffer)
- Expecting 10 in-person (we will confirm by Sept 10)
- We have 3 dedicated huddle rooms with wired ethernet; need to verify whether we can provision a fourth (ops@apsilon is looped).

One ask: Jordan will join remotely from London on day 2 morning — can we set a dedicated remote chair for his sessions at 8:00 PT (16:00 BST)? We'll need clear handoff notes in the agenda.

Alex
Director, Product Strategy — Apsilon

Subject: RE: APSILON logistics — AV & room assignments (internal)

Ben / Marissa —

I spoke to Ops about the room setup. We can cover 4 simultaneous rooms if we bring our USB AV pack + one vendor-supplied PTZ camera (we'll ship overnight). Recommend we set a hard limit: no more than 3 live concurrent interactive sessions with the 4th as streaming-only to simplify latency for remote chairs.

I also drafted the timezone-friendly presenter matrix: EMEA presenters get pre-record slots + live Q&A during PT afternoon (1400–1700 PT). I'll attach the matrix and a pared-down runbook for remote chair ops.

Tessa
Senior Events Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: Revised: APSILON workshop itinerary + calendar holds (please confirm)

Alex / Ops team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on Alex and Tessa's input, here's the updated plan:

- Day 1 (Sept 20): Kickoff 11:00–17:00 PT, 2 breakout blocks (13:00–14:15 PT / 15:00–16:15 PT). In-person capacity: 10 seats.
- Day 2 (Sept 21): 09:00–12:30 PT core sessions, 13:30–16:00 PT remote Q&A block to accommodate EMEA. Jordan to join remotely at 08:00 PT for a leadership check-in (we'll set a hard start for his segment at 08:15 PT).
- Day 3 (Sept 22): Remote buffer day; all sessions virtual. 11:00–15:00 PT fallback schedule in case travel is delayed.

Calendar holds: I'm going to send tentative calendar invites today for the three-day window (Sept 20–22) with All/Optional invites per Alex's confirmation. Please confirm the 4th AV room availability by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize the site map.

Attachments included: site_map_floor2.pdf (ops will confirm ethernet run), apsilon_draft_itinerary.xlsx (updated with times), remote_fallback_runbook.md.

Ben
